phase3_findings.description: The diff edits the dated, already-published May 20, 2026 release-note entry for memory.save_queries, removing the clause 'and still saves free-form notes'. The issue asked that dated release-note and changelog entries be left unedited; only the first ## Unreleased section was to gain the new entry, which it correctly does at line 11. The edit also makes that release's description of shipped behavior less accurate, because at that release SQL Lens did still save free-form notes with save_queries off. Behavior-inert prose cap applied: capped at Important (first-conjunct=held, limb-one=held, limb-two=not-held), so it takes no self-contradicting-diff carve-out.

Blank-string-reads-as-off tolerance is added only for save_text_memories; siblings save_queries, allow_import and allow_admin_tools still reject a blank environment variable, so the same operator mistake behaves differently across the memory flags and nothing documents the split. Corroborated by prflow:requesting-code-review (F-9).

The new helper _prompt_from_agent_tools declares its parameter as `object` and then calls agent.get_available_tools(user), giving up static checking on the one seam the three new prompt assertions depend on. Corroborated by prflow:pr-test-analyzer (F-7).

The save_queries field description still says the system prompt 'drops its save instructions automatically' when the flag is off, while this change establishes in the internal docs that 'Do NOT forget to save successful executions.' survives under has_search. The doc files were corrected in this diff; this untouched description is the last statement of the superseded claim.

In the save_text_memory block comment, only the last three lines name a specific wrong change and its consequence; the first five restate what the adjacent gate line and the sibling save_queries comment already convey.

The enabled-path registration test only exercises save_text_memories=True built directly into MemoryConfig. Acceptance criterion three also names the environment-variable route reaching build_agent, which is covered only at the config layer, so the full composition from environment variable to prompt is inferred rather than exercised. Small risk, a completeness nicety.
Same defect as F-3: the new prompt helper is typed `object` while dereferencing an Agent-only method, so a rename of Agent.get_available_tools would surface only as a runtime AttributeError.

The manifest always sets SQLLENS_MEMORY__SAVE_TEXT_MEMORIES, but nothing in this change establishes what an upgraded bundle install substitutes for a user_config field with no stored value. An unreplaced literal placeholder would fail config load and stop startup, with no pull-request-time signal because mcpb.yml runs on tags and manual dispatches only. Pre-existing shape, also present for read_only.
Same defect as F-2: save_text_memories is the only MemoryConfig boolean with blank-string tolerance, so the asymmetry is a trap for an operator who exports an unset shell variable for a sibling flag.

## Verdict: APPROVE with notes (one Important and eight Suggestion findings, all below the `critical` threshold)

This PR is ready to merge: every one of the thirty-seven checklist items passed, all five acceptance criteria are itemized and verified, and no finding reaches the threshold that blocks a merge — though the edit to a published, dated release-note entry is worth a quick fix before or just after merge.

Rule applied: rule 6 — a finding below the threshold remains → APPROVE with notes

## Code Review Findings

### 🟠 Important / Major

1. `docs/external/release-notes.md` line 73 — the diff edits the dated, already-published **May 20, 2026** entry for `memory.save_queries`, removing the clause "and still saves free-form notes" from it. The issue's Documentation Needed section asked that the dated release-note and changelog entries, and the internal v0.1.0 production-readiness audit page, be left unedited; only the first `## Unreleased` section was to gain the new entry, which it correctly does at line 11. Removing the clause also makes that release's description of shipped behavior less accurate, because at the May 20, 2026 release SQL Lens did still save free-form notes with `save_queries` off. A sibling sweep found no other dated entry altered, and `docs/internal/production-readiness-v0.1.0.md` line 70 was correctly left alone. (raised by 1/5 agents) <!-- inertness: first-conjunct=held limb-one=held limb-two=not-held; evidence: the finding's subject is the sentence itself and no mechanism's covered set, branch or output changes if the clause is restored; searched the repository's .sh, .py, .yml, .json and workflow consumers for readers of this file — .github/workflows/release.yml builds its own release-notes.md from CHANGELOG.md, and .prflow/config.json only names docs/external/release-notes.md as a file an agent-run doc step maintains, which does not make it tool-read for behavior; limb two fails because docs/external/ is a published, reader-facing page -->

### 🟡 Suggestion / Minor (8)

<details><summary>8 items</summary>

1. `src/sqllens/config.py` lines 218 to 227 — the new blank-string-reads-as-off tolerance is added only for `save_text_memories`. Its siblings `save_queries` (line 169), `allow_import` (line 194) and `allow_admin_tools` (line 204) still reject a blank environment variable, so `SQLLENS_MEMORY__SAVE_QUERIES=` — the classic unset-shell-variable expansion that the new test `test_blank_save_text_memories_env_loads_as_off` exists to cover — still fails config load while the identically shaped new flag loads silently off. The narrowness is deliberate and a typo such as `ture` still raises, pinned by `tests/unit/test_config_schema.py` lines 538 to 548, so this is a consistency trap for the next operator rather than a silent failure in the new field. `read_only` in `mcpb/manifest.json` line 189 is mapped the same way and has the same exposure. (raised by 2/5 agents)
2. `tests/unit/test_factory_wiring.py` — the new helper is declared `async def _prompt_from_agent_tools(agent: object) -> str` and then calls `agent.get_available_tools(user)`. `Agent.get_available_tools` does exist, so the helper works, but typing the parameter as `object` while dereferencing an `Agent`-only method gives up static checking on the one seam the three new prompt assertions depend on. A rename or signature change on that method would surface only as a runtime `AttributeError`. (raised by 2/5 agents)
3. `src/sqllens/config.py` lines 167 to 176 — the `save_queries` field description still says the system prompt "drops its save instructions automatically" when the flag is off. This change establishes elsewhere, in `docs/internal/agent/memory.md` and `docs/internal/setup/config-loading.md`, that one save instruction survives: `Do NOT forget to save successful executions.` is emitted under `if has_search`, which is registered unconditionally. The doc files were corrected in this diff, so this untouched description is now the only remaining statement of the superseded claim. (raised by 1/5 agents)
4. `src/sqllens/agent/factory.py` lines 132 to 140 — in the `save_text_memory` block comment, only the last three lines name a specific wrong change and its consequence, namely not moving the gate into `execute` or `save_text_memory` because curated imports share that path. The first five restate what the adjacent `if cfg.memory.save_text_memories:` line and the sibling `save_queries` comment already convey, making the comment longer than naming that wrong change requires. (raised by 1/5 agents)
5. `tests/unit/test_factory_wiring.py` lines 501 to 513 — the enabled-path registration test only exercises `save_text_memories=True` built directly into `MemoryConfig` via `build_test_config`. Acceptance criterion three also names the environment-variable route, `SQLLENS_MEMORY__SAVE_TEXT_MEMORIES=true` with no TOML key, reaching `build_agent`; that route is covered only at the config layer in `tests/unit/test_config_schema.py` line 339, so the full composition from environment variable through `Config.load` and `build_agent` to the prompt is inferred rather than exercised. The risk is small because the gate reads the same field, so this is a completeness nicety rather than a real gap. (raised by 1/5 agents)
6. `mcpb/manifest.json` line 30 — the manifest now always sets `SQLLENS_MEMORY__SAVE_TEXT_MEMORIES`, but nothing in this change establishes what an upgraded bundle install substitutes for a `user_config` field it has no stored value for. Empty and whitespace values are absorbed by the new validator, but an unreplaced literal `${user_config.save_text_memories}` would fail config load and stop startup, with no pull-request-time signal because `.github/workflows/mcpb.yml` runs on tags and manual dispatches only. The same exposure already exists for `read_only`, so this is pre-existing shape rather than a regression, and the issue records it as unestablished. (raised by 1/5 agents)

</details>
